text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Cyprus press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Clerides says he will proceed with a cabinet reshuffle only when he thinks it is necessary.
- 12 more cases of meningitis in past 24 hours.
- Russian Federation supports strengthening of U.N. role in resolving Cyprus problem.
- Dhekelia-Famagusta road rerouted for economic and security reasons, government spokesman says.
- Ministry of Finance evaluating different scenarios for increasing military defence fund levy.
